nd.text:
This is the script that makes each letter do its thing. 

You can add new special effects in here if you'd like!

ng.text:
Here are the scripts for fast/slow print, setting/resetting variables, etc. 
You can edit them if you want, but you probably won't need to.

Lol I made it as clean as I could but my code is still so messy, so I apologize. xD

nh.text:
>>>>>>>>>>      LOOK HERE     <<<<<<<<<<<<

Down below are the main scripts you'll want to use. 

If you get confused on how to use this, please ask your questions in the comments and I (or someone else) will probably be able to help you out.

Over to the right is the clone script, so you can edit what each individual letter does >>>>

ni.text: ^ Sets Special Effects in-script.    Useful if you want the text effects to change part way through the project.   Put 1 for on, 0 for off.

nj.text: ^ Sets the main text settings in-script.   Useful if you want the text to change part way through the project.

nk.text: ^ Prints text with whatever settings you input.   It ignores the current text setting variables.   Useful if you want to print one line in a different style than the rest of the text.

nl.text: Resets all text settings to default

nm.text: Erases all letters that are currently on-screen

nn.text: Shows all variable sliders, so that you can choose the text settings easily

no.text: Prints text at the x and y location.  It uses the text/special effects settings.

np.text:
Each Letter is a Clone.

This script controls what each letter does.

If you want to add/edit a special effect, here is the place to do it.

nq.text:
Delete this comment and use this big open space to make your scripts using the blocks shown above. 

You can make it write text when the flag is pressed, when something is broadcast, etc. Enjoy! :)
